]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure the column is integer type as per target schema
    df['last_credit_pull_d'] = df['last_credit_pull_d'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the exact same schema as the target,
# we can concatenate (union) all source tables vertically.
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The target schema is ['last_credit_pull_d'] with integer type,
# so ensure the final DataFrame matches this.
target_df = target_df[['last_credit_pull_d']].copy()
target_df['last_credit_pull_d'] = target_df['last_credit_pull_d'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the specified output path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_57/target_multisource_cot.csv"
target_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
